name: Demo Safe
description: First-party demo module using only safe permissions. Exposes demo_ping (returns current time via the broker) and demo_notes (exercises module-scoped memory + data/public/<moduleId>/ reads).

tools.name: demo_ping
tools.description: Ping the demo-safe module and get the current time back. Useful to prove the module framework is wired end-to-end.

note.description: Optional note to include in the reply.

tools.name: demo_notes
tools.description: Reads or writes a module-scoped note by key. If 'value' is provided, writes it. If an 'intro.md' file exists under data/public/com.p2claw.demo-safe/, it is returned alongside the note.

key.description: The note key to read or write.

value.description: If provided, the value to store under 'key'. Omit to read only.
